Vehicle assets
==============

hatchback-sports.glb is from Kenney's "Car Kit".

  https://kenney.nl/assets/car-kit
  License: CC0 1.0 (see LICENSE-kenney.txt)

The model ships the body and all four wheels as separate nodes
(wheel-front-left, wheel-front-right, wheel-back-left, wheel-back-right), which
the runtime drives independently from the CANNON.RaycastVehicle wheel
transforms — giving steering yaw on the front pair and rolling spin on all four.

Textures/colormap.png is the kit's shared colour atlas, referenced by the GLB.

Scale (see CAR in src/models.js): the source model is 2.85 m long and is scaled
uniformly by 1.4035 to a 4.0 m car, giving 1.82 m width and 1.54 m height.
